body.name: positive-noise SCM completion
body.construction: Given \(\operatorname{Cert}(\theta,T,t)\), set \(W_t=QP_t^{\mathsf T}Q_{tt}^{-1}\), \(A_t=W_tL_t\), \(U_t=\begin{psmallmatrix}L_t&0\\A_{t,T^c}&I_{d-r}\end{psmallmatrix}\) after placing \(t\) first, \(B_t=I_d-U_t^{-1}\), choose \(0<\tau<\lambda_{\min}(\Sigma_0)/(2(\lVert U_t\rVert_{\mathrm{op}}^2+1))\), set \(R_0=\Sigma_0-\tau U_tU_t^{\mathsf T}-\tau I_d\), set \(C_t=U_t^{-1}R_0^{1/2}\), take \(H_e\sim N(0,I_d)\), baseline structural and measurement covariances \(\tau I_d\), and target increments \(\operatorname{diag}(\Lambda_{e,t})\) on \(t\) with zero increments off \(T\).
